# truenas_smb_share (List Resource)

Lists existing `sharing.smb` objects for `terraform query`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `query_filters` (String) Middleware query filters as JSON, e.g. `jsonencode([["pool", "=", "tank"]])`. Combined with any filters the resource always applies.
